originalFamilyScopeSummary: Fix pay with token UI issues in lite mode including error handling and button visibility
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: Fix pay with token UI issues in lite mode including error handling and button visibility
notes: The inherited 21-node recipe re-ran green against branch + origin/main after the rebase, re-asserting every original AC: AC1 no stacked funding errors and no 'Available: $0' row after switching the payment method to a wallet token, AC2 the place-order button present immediately after the switch and once it settles, AC3+AC4 the unresolved-balance and below-minimum funding states via the 'pay with token funding state' Jest block (17 passed, exit 0 asserted by assert_exit_code). This round's single review comment was in-scope for the same family goal — the place-order button could still enable for ~300ms on a wallet token that cannot fund the trade, because the isDisabled list gated on the debounced validation verdict rather than the synchronous hasInsufficientPayTokenBalance the funding message already used. Fixed in 27e68e176f5 with a regression test verified to fail without the change. No part of the original scope was deferred; the only untriaged signal is a non-blocking Android performance-test error reported by CI with no assertion detail and no link to the changed files.
